purpose.zh: 深度拉伸后腿髋前侧和前腿大腿内侧
purpose.en: Deeply stretch the front of the back hip and the inner front thigh.

text.en: Let your hips sink slowly forward and down

text.zh: 前脚远远踩在前方，后膝跪地
text.en: Plant the front foot far forward and kneel on the back knee.

text.zh: 双手扶砖，手臂放松伸直
text.en: Rest your hands on the blocks with soft, straight arms.

commonErrors.zh: 前膝内扣或超过脚尖太多
commonErrors.en: Letting the front knee cave in or drift far past the toes.

cautions.zh: 跪地膝下垫软垫；拉伸处疼痛时减小幅度
cautions.en: Pad under the kneeling knee, and ease off if the stretch hurts.
